body.objective: Prove the uniform high-mode domain, invertibility and priming estimates needed to turn the exact scalar-flat Berger vector blocks into a legitimate resolvent and relative-trace carrier.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal low-block vector-Schur theorem.  Proceed only if it exports a unique self-adjoint vector pencil and normalization.  Derive exact eigenvalue or singular-value lower bounds for A_jmn(t) on a declared complex-t neighbourhood and all sufficiently large |n|+j; classify the finite exceptional block set exactly; prove uniform bounds for A^-1, d, delta and the order-minus-two Schur correction in the normalized representation norm; identify every scalar/vector zero mode and matched zero-pole factor; and obtain explicit summable majorants for the first three metric-insertion traces.  Verify the bounds on exact low modes and with an independent interval/representation rail.  Export either a complete coercivity/tail preflight or the first exact direction in which the claimed uniform estimate fails.
body.current_gate: uniform vector-Schur resolvent and insertion-tail bounds
body.forbid: no asymptotic O-symbol without explicit uniform constants and threshold; no finite cutoff called convergence; no scalar Laplacian coercivity substituted for the coupled vector pencil; no ignored exceptional denominator or zero mode; no local heat coefficient used as a global tail; no finite five-function or QME promotion
activates: the complete primed Berger Schur spectral measure and certified finite traces
body.resource_hint: GLOBAL ANALYSIS PRELIGHT.  Coordinate with M21/M23; exact low blocks and certified interval tails are different evidence types and must remain separately tagged.
notes: This gate is deliberately before det3 or five-function assembly: an uncontrolled high-mode tail cannot support a finite global coefficient.
